name: jira-plans-enhanced
description: Chrome extension enhancing Jira Plans with headcount tracking, resource visibility, and productivity features
author: Adrian Birsan

scripts.test:e2e:injection: npm run build:test && playwright test e2e/injection-after-permission.spec.ts
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm test && npm run clean && npm run bundle && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:dev: npm run clean && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:test: npm run clean && npm run bundle:dev && npm run copy-assets:test
scripts.copy-assets:test: cp manifest.test.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/icons && mkdir -p dist/popup && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup/popup.html && cp src/popup/popup.css dist/popup/popup.css
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:content && npm run bundle:popup && npm run bundle:background
scripts.bundle:dev: npm run bundle:content:dev && npm run bundle:popup:dev && npm run bundle:background:dev
scripts.copy-assets: cp manifest.dist.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons dist/icons && mkdir -p dist/popup && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup/popup.html && cp src/popup/popup.css dist/popup/popup.css
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../jira-plans-enhanced.zip .
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && node scripts/check-versions.js
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-versions.js && git add manifest.json manifest.dist.json
